tools.name: get_competitor_changes
tools.description: Use for "what are my competitors doing?". Returns recent changes in the brand's chosen competitors' Meta ads: who changed what (number of ads, angle, format) and when. Competitors are set in the Run1Ads app. Saved data, refreshed weekly.

Returns the fixes the user chose to do, filtered by status (open, done or all, default all), each with its fix_id and, once newer data is saved, whether the tracked number moved after the fix was marked done. tools.name: add_to_fix_list
tools.description: Add a fix to the brand's Run1Ads fix list. Pass item_key from get_today to add that finding with its steps and the number to track, or pass your own title. Writes to Run1Ads only. Nothing changes in Meta or on your store.

tools.name: mark_fix_done
tools.description: Mark a fix on the fix list as done. Run1Ads records the number at that moment so it can show whether the fix worked once newer data is saved. Writes to Run1Ads only.

tools.name: ask_consultant
tools.description: Ask the Run1Ads consultant a question about this brand in plain English. It answers from the saved account data only, with exact steps you can apply. It advises only and never changes anything. Up to 10 questions per brand per day, shared with the app.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "rpc" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_store_checks, get_ad_copy_review · Private data: mark_fix_done · Public sink: send_paused_draft · Destructive: get_performance, get_ad_copy_review, get_audiences, get_competitor_changes.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_store_checks, get_ad_copy_review · Private data: mark_fix_done · Public sink: send_paused_draft · Destructive: get_performance, get_ad_copy_review, get_audiences, get_competitor_changes

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
